Package org.zvec.binding

Class IndexParams

java.lang.Object
org.zvec.binding.IndexParams
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class IndexParams extends Object implements AutoCloseable
High-level wrapper for zvec_index_params_t.

Use the static factory methods to create type-specific parameters:

  • createHNSW(MetricType, int, int)
  • createHNSWQuantized(MetricType, int, int, QuantizeType)
  • createIVF(MetricType, int, int, boolean)

  • createIvfRabitq(MetricType, int, int, int)
  • createVamana(MetricType, int, int, float, boolean, boolean)
  • createInvert(boolean, boolean)
  • createFTS(String, String[], String)

    • createDiskAnn

      public static IndexParams createDiskAnn(MetricType metricType, int maxDegree, int listSize, int pqChunkNum)
      Create DiskANN index parameters.
      Parameters:
      metricType - distance metric
      maxDegree - graph connectivity (max degree of the Vamana graph)
      listSize - build-time list size (candidate list during construction)
      pqChunkNum - PQ chunk count (0 disables PQ)

    • createDiskAnnQuantized

      public static IndexParams createDiskAnnQuantized(MetricType metricType, int maxDegree, int listSize, int pqChunkNum, QuantizeType quantizeType)

    • createIvfRabitq

      public static IndexParams createIvfRabitq(MetricType metricType, int nlist, int totalBits, int sampleCount)
      Create IVF RaBitQ index parameters.
      Parameters:
      metricType - distance metric
      nlist - number of cluster centers
      totalBits - total bits for RaBitQ quantization
      sampleCount - sample count for training; 0 means use all vectors

    • createVamana

      public static IndexParams createVamana(MetricType metricType, int maxDegree, int searchListSize, float alpha, boolean saturateGraph, boolean useContiguousMemory)
      Create Vamana index parameters.
      Parameters:
      metricType - distance metric
      maxDegree - maximum out-degree
      searchListSize - construction candidate list size
      alpha - RobustPrune alpha factor (e.g. 1.2)
      saturateGraph - force every node to reach max_degree
      useContiguousMemory - allocate a contiguous memory arena

      Create an FTS (full-text search) index parameter set.
      Parameters:

      filters - filter chain, e.g. new String[]{"lowercase"}
      extraParams - optional extra params JSON (may be null)
